The workbook generation failed due to Excel #NAME? errors in the statistics section, indicating invalid formula names or missing functions.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected numerical values (e.g., H46 expected -1.591577, got #NAME?). This error typically occurs when openpyxl writes a formula containing a function name that Excel or the verifier does not recognize, or when a named range is missing.
